ex.en: Children like outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 孩子們喜歡戶外活動。

ex.en: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有戶外游泳池。

ex.en: The outdoor concert was cancelled because of the rain.
ex.zh: 露天演唱會因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: Is the power cord plugged into a power outlet?
ex.zh: 電源線有插到插座上嗎？

ex.en: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
ex.zh: 我把果醬灑到插座上，結果短路了。

outlet.zh: 銷售據點；暢貨中心（outlet mall）

ex.en: We bought shoes at the outlet mall.
ex.zh: 我們在暢貨中心買了鞋子。

ex.en: The company has 200 retail outlets in Asia.
ex.zh: 這家公司在亞洲有 200 個銷售據點。

ex.en: Sports are a good outlet for stress.
ex.zh: 運動是很好的紓壓管道。

ex.en: Music is my outlet when I'm upset.
ex.zh: 心情不好時，音樂是我的出口。

ex.en: This software is outdated and needs an update.
ex.zh: 這個軟體已經過時，需要更新。

ex.en: The information on the website is outdated.
ex.zh: 網站上的資訊已經過時了。

outlook.zh: 看法、觀點（outlook on life：人生觀）

ex.en: Let go of your negative outlook on life.
ex.zh: 放下你對人生的負面看法吧。

ex.en: He has a positive outlook on life.
ex.zh: 他的人生觀很正面。

ex.en: The economic outlook for next year is uncertain.
ex.zh: 明年的經濟前景不明朗。

ex.en: The company's outlook remains strong.
ex.zh: 這家公司的前景依然看好。

ex.en: You look great in that white outfit.
ex.zh: 你穿那套白色衣服很好看。

ex.en: Your outfit today is so gorgeous!
ex.zh: 你今天的穿搭好漂亮！

ex.en: I need a new outfit for the job interview.
ex.zh: 我需要一套新衣服去面試。

ex.en: He works for a small consulting outfit in Taipei.
ex.zh: 他在台北一家小型顧問公司上班。

ex.en: It's a small outfit with just ten employees.
ex.zh: 那是一家只有十名員工的小公司。

ex.en: A power outage hit the whole neighborhood last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚整個社區都停電了。

ex.en: The network outage lasted for three hours.
ex.zh: 網路中斷了三個小時。

ex.en: I was an outsider, so to speak.
ex.zh: 可以說，我是個局外人。

ex.en: As a newcomer, I felt like an outsider.
ex.zh: 身為新人，我覺得自己像個外人。

ex.en: The company hired an outsider as CEO.
ex.zh: 公司聘請外部人士擔任執行長。

ex.en: The company saw a large cash outflow this quarter.
ex.zh: 公司本季有大量現金流出。

ex.en: Capital outflows weakened the currency.
ex.zh: 資本外流使該國貨幣走弱。

ex.en: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
ex.zh: 跨國企業的表現優於只在單一國家營運的傳統企業。

ex.en: The stock outperformed the market this year.
ex.zh: 這支股票今年的表現優於大盤。

outright.zh: 徹底地、完全地；一次付清地

ex.en: They bought the building outright.
ex.zh: 他們一次付清買下了那棟大樓。

ex.en: Smoking is banned outright in the office.
ex.zh: 辦公室全面禁菸。

ex.en: The project was an outright failure.
ex.zh: 這個專案徹底失敗了。

ex.en: She won an outright victory.
ex.zh: 她取得了壓倒性的勝利。

ex.en: The price increase caused outrage among customers.
ex.zh: 漲價引起顧客的憤怒。

ex.en: There was public outrage over the decision.
ex.zh: 這個決定引發了公憤。

ex.en: Fans were outraged by the ticket prices.
ex.zh: 票價讓粉絲們很憤怒。

ex.en: His comments outraged many employees.
ex.zh: 他的言論激怒了許多員工。

ex.en: The board voted to oust the CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會投票撤換執行長。

ex.en: He was ousted from the company last year.
ex.zh: 他去年被趕出公司。

ex.en: The initial outlay for the equipment was quite high.
ex.zh: 這套設備的初期支出相當高。

ex.en: The project requires a large capital outlay.
ex.zh: 這個專案需要一大筆資本支出。

ex.en: The benefits outweigh the risks.
ex.zh: 好處大於風險。

ex.en: The advantages far outweigh the costs.
ex.zh: 優點遠遠超過成本。

ex.en: The next four to six weeks are crucial in controlling the massive Ebola outbreak.
ex.zh: 接下來四到六週是控制這波伊波拉疫情大爆發的關鍵。

ex.en: There was an outbreak of food poisoning at the school.
ex.zh: 那所學校爆發了食物中毒事件。

ounce.zh: 盎司（重量單位，約 28 公克）

ex.en: Add two ounces of sugar to the mixture.
ex.zh: 在混合物裡加入兩盎司的糖。

ex.en: This steak weighs eight ounces.
ex.zh: 這塊牛排重八盎司。

ex.en: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
ex.zh: 一分預防勝過十分治療。

ex.en: There isn't an ounce of truth in that story.
ex.zh: 那個故事沒有半點真實性。

ex.en: Layla was very outgoing, loving, and caring.
ex.zh: 萊拉個性外向、有愛心，又很會照顧人。

ex.en: Sales jobs suit outgoing people.
ex.zh: 業務工作適合個性外向的人。

ex.en: The outgoing CEO will stay on as an adviser.
ex.zh: 即將卸任的執行長會留任顧問。

ex.en: We held a farewell party for the outgoing manager.
ex.zh: 我們為即將離職的經理辦了歡送會。

ex.en: All outgoing mail is collected at 4 p.m.
ex.zh: 所有寄出的郵件在下午四點收件。

ex.en: This phone can't make outgoing calls.
ex.zh: 這支電話不能撥出。

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 比起出門，我寧願待在家。

ex.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
ex.zh: 穿上鞋子，我們出去吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: Sorry, she's out at the moment.
ex.zh: 抱歉，她現在不在。

ex.en: My manager is out today.
ex.zh: 我主管今天不在。

ex.en: The lights went out during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨時燈全熄了。

ex.en: We've run out of printer paper.
ex.zh: 印表機的紙用完了。

ex.en: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.
ex.zh: 要是這件事傳出去，我就麻煩了。

ex.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
ex.zh: 員工下班回家後，發生了火災。

ex.en: Her new album comes out next month.
ex.zh: 她的新專輯下個月發行。

ex.en: It's a rainy day, so we can't play outside.
ex.zh: 今天下雨，我們不能在外面玩。

ex.en: If you are going to smoke, please go outside.
ex.zh: 如果你要抽菸，請到外面去。

ex.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
ex.zh: 數百人在售票處外面等著。

ex.en: It's hard to get a taxi outside the station.
ex.zh: 在車站外面很難叫到計程車。

ex.en: Can I make an outside call on this phone?
ex.zh: 我可以用這支電話打外線嗎？

ex.en: We hired an outside company to design the website.
ex.zh: 我們請了外部公司設計網站。

ex.en: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
ex.zh: 我覺得你應該跟她道歉。

ex.en: You ought to get to work on time.
ex.zh: 你應該準時上班。

ex.en: You ought to know better at your age.
ex.zh: 你這個年紀應該更懂事才對。

ex.en: Regardless what you may do, the outcome will still be the same.
ex.zh: 不管你怎麼做，結果都會一樣。

ex.en: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
ex.zh: 測試結果顯示，系統已符合所有設計要求。

ex.en: We are waiting for the outcome of the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們正在等會議的結果。

ex.en: Remove the outer layer of the onion.
ex.zh: 把洋蔥最外層剝掉。

ex.en: The outer walls of the building are made of glass.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓的外牆是玻璃做的。

ex.en: How do you find food in outer space?
ex.zh: 在外太空要怎麼找食物？

ex.en: Have you ever been to outer space?
ex.zh: 你去過外太空嗎？

outing.zh: 出遊、郊遊；（團體的）外出活動

ex.en: Our team went on a company outing to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們團隊去海邊參加公司出遊。

ex.en: The school is planning an outing to the zoo.
ex.zh: 學校正在計畫去動物園校外教學。

ex.en: The party will be held outdoors, weather permitting.
ex.zh: 如果天氣允許，派對將在戶外舉行。

ex.en: She doesn't get outdoors much.
ex.zh: 她不常到戶外走動。

ex.en: We had lunch outdoors on the terrace.
ex.zh: 我們在露台上吃午餐。

ex.en: He loves the great outdoors.
ex.zh: 他熱愛大自然。

ex.en: The trip lets kids enjoy the outdoors.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行讓孩子們享受戶外活動。

outrageous.zh: 令人吃驚的、無法無天的、可恥的

ex.en: The price of the hotel room was outrageous.
ex.zh: 那間旅館的房價貴得離譜。

ex.en: It is outrageous that he was never punished.
ex.zh: 他從未受到懲罰，這實在令人憤慨。

ex.en: The factory increased its output by 20%.
ex.zh: 工廠的產量提高了 20%。

ex.en: Our output is lower than last year.
ex.zh: 我們的產量比去年低。

ex.en: Check the output of the program for errors.
ex.zh: 檢查程式的輸出有沒有錯誤。

ex.en: The printer is an output device.
ex.zh: 印表機是一種輸出裝置。

ex.en: Many companies outsource their customer service.
ex.zh: 很多公司把客服外包出去。

ex.en: We decided to outsource the design work.
ex.zh: 我們決定把設計工作外包。

ex.en: The elevator seems to be out of order.
ex.zh: 電梯好像故障了。

ex.en: Unfortunately, the telephone was out of order.
ex.zh: 不巧的是，電話壞了。

ex.en: The machine is out of order.
ex.zh: 那臺機器壞掉了。

ex.en: He put the books on the shelf out of order.
ex.zh: 他把書亂七八糟地放到書架上。

ex.en: The pages of the report are out of order.
ex.zh: 這份報告的頁碼順序亂了。

ex.en: Sorry, the book is out of stock.
ex.zh: 不好意思，這本書缺貨了。

ex.en: We're out of stock now.
ex.zh: 我們現在沒有庫存了。

ex.en: The bank launched an outreach program to help small exporters understand trade finance.
ex.zh: 銀行推出推廣計畫，協助小型出口商了解貿易融資。

ex.en: Our outreach team visited local schools to introduce the apprenticeship program.
ex.zh: 我們的推廣團隊走訪當地學校，介紹學徒培訓計畫。

ex.en: The clinic serves outpatients from the surrounding communities.
ex.zh: 這間診所為周邊社區的門診病人提供服務。

ex.en: Outpatients can collect their prescriptions at the ground-floor pharmacy.
ex.zh: 門診病人可以在一樓藥局領取處方藥。

ex.en: The plan limits how much patients pay out of pocket each year.
ex.zh: 這項方案設有病人每年自付費用的上限。

ex.en: She paid for the repair out of pocket while the claim was reviewed.
ex.zh: 理賠申請審核期間，她先自掏腰包支付維修費。

ex.en: Write an outline before you start your essay.
ex.zh: 開始寫文章之前先擬大綱。

ex.en: He gave us a brief outline of the plan.
ex.zh: 他向我們簡要說明了計畫的大概。

ex.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
ex.zh: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。

ex.en: We could see the outline of the mountains in the fog.
ex.zh: 我們在霧中看得到山的輪廓。

ex.en: The report outlines three possible solutions.
ex.zh: 這份報告概述了三種可能的解決方案。

ex.en: Could you outline your main points?
ex.zh: 可以概述一下你的重點嗎？

ex.en: He came across an outstanding young person.
ex.zh: 他遇到了一位傑出的年輕人。

ex.en: He's a man of outstanding character.
ex.zh: 他的人品出眾。

ex.en: We express our gratitude for Mr Smith's outstanding, challenging speech.
ex.zh: 感謝史密斯先生精彩又發人深省的演講。

ex.en: You have an outstanding balance of 300 dollars.
ex.zh: 您還有 300 美元的款項未付清。

ex.en: There are still a few outstanding issues.
ex.zh: 還有幾個問題沒有解決。
